title: Design and export scoped quotation conversion reports to Excel
description: A salesperson uses a visual field selector in the existing quotation report to preview and download a bounded original-currency conversion report. Add a finite server-defined field catalog and request/page DTO with start/end and ordered selected field keys; grouping remains the established salesperson/currency buckets. Validate duplicate/unknown/empty keys, bounded dates and output shape before reads. New preview and Excel endpoints must independently recheck authenticated identity, quotation menu and current customer scope and invoke the prerequisite service; no model-generated queries or client-provided totals. The designer retains field order and dates across preview and Excel, displays source-limit/error/empty states, and is reachable from the existing report action. Excel uses the existing ExcelExporter, numeric counts/decimals, safe formula-leading labels, date context and explicit original-currency grouping; it never appends mixed-currency grand money totals or silently exports unbounded details. No new DB model or registration is required; the controller reuses injected IReportService and IErpDbContext. Development only: reuse existing ERP services, current-user menu permissions and SalespersonDataScopeService; OperationLogMiddleware audits API calls. No new authorization privileges, direct table writes, arbitrary SQL, schema/migration/stored-procedure/view changes, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible actions, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real browser acceptance. Verify focused in-memory or source-contract tests and the configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external environments must be marked blocked, never reported passed. Preserve unrelated work.
acceptance_criteria: A finite catalog and validated request/page DTO support ordered field selection; preview validates inputs and rechecks current identity/menu/customer scope before using bounded salesperson/currency conversion data.

The existing quotation report action opens a field-selection designer that retains dates and column order across preview/Excel and shows loading, denied, validation, source-limit and empty states with safe text rendering.

Excel independently reauthorizes and validates, exports only server-derived preview rows using typed cells and formula-safe text, and labels dates/original currency without mixed-currency money totals; focused API/workbook/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
